hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook where each pool configures its own launch rules at creation: allowlist, anti-snipe window, buy burn, LP rewards, treasury fee, sell tax, trading start time, wallet cap, same-block guard, liquidity lock, exit decay, volatility fee, and sandwich guard. Rules are immutable after pool creation. A fixed 0.10% platform fee is taken on every swap in the paired token. Only exact-input swaps are supported.
